chunks: I do not think anyone is welcomed as a newborn with the water of the Euphrates except that he would love us, the People of the Household.
And he (peace be upon him) said: The people of Kufa do not quench themselves with the water of the Euphrates except for a certain matter.
And he said: Two water-spouts from Paradise flow into it.

key_terms.أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ: Ahl al-Bayt — the People of the Household of the Prophet Muhammad, comprising the Prophet, Ali, Fatima, and the eleven Imams
key_terms.الْفُرَات: Al-Furat — the Euphrates River, which holds deep significance in Islamic history and is near the holy sites of Karbala and Najaf
key_terms.مِيزَابَانِ: Two water-spouts/channels — a cosmological statement about the Euphrates' connection to Paradise
key_terms.يُحَنَّكُ: Tahnik — the Islamic practice of placing something sweet (or water) on the palate of a newborn as a blessing and to initiate the child into faith

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Sadiq say about the spiritual merits of the water of the Euphrates (al-Furat)?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) attributed a spiritual quality to the water of the Euphrates River (al-Furat), asserting that newborns welcomed with it develop love for the Ahl al-Bayt, that the people of Kufa drink it for a divinely ordained purpose, and that two channels from Paradise flow into it. This reflects a broader Shia tradition of attaching religious significance to the Euphrates, which flows near the holy sites of Karbala and Najaf in Iraq, and establishes a metaphysical link between the river and the blessings of the Prophet's household.
word_analysis: is welcomed (as a newborn with water placed in mouth)

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Al Husayn Bin Usman, form Muhammad Bin Abu Hamza, from the one who mentioned it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘There is no one who is welcomed (newborn) with the water of the Euphrates except that he would love us<sup>asws</sup> the People<sup>asws</sup> of the Household’.
And he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The people of Al-Kufa do not quench themselves with the water of Euphrates except for a matter’.
And he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Therein diffuse two water-spouts from the paradise’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from af-Husayn ibn ‘Uthman from Muhammad ibn abu Hamzah from those whom he has mentioned who has said the following: “In whoever ’s mouth water of Euphrates is dropped in childhood, I do not think he will not love us, people of the house.’
He (the Imam) said, ‘People of al-Kufah were not made to drink water of Euphrates except for a certain matter.’
He (the Imam) said, ‘Two shoots of water fall in it (Euphrates) from the garden (paradise).”’
